anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard, which is a technical specification used to organize and share EEG data like the one in this dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz. Participants performed a P300 speller task with a 6x6 character grid, with visual stimuli presented to elicit target and non-target event-related potentials. The trial interval was 0-1.0 seconds, and data were collected in a single session per subject.
